🎯 The first release of Aim Assist: Oblivion Remastered style controller aim assist for Skyrim.

## ✨ What's new in 1.0
- 🧲 **Friction and magnetism:** the camera slows down over a target and the crosshair is gently pulled toward it while you move the right stick.
- 🏹 **Ranged by default:** works with bows, crossbows and spells, on hostile targets in line of sight, with your weapon drawn.
- ⚙️ **MCM menu:** tune everything in game, and changes apply within about a second.

---

## 🎮 What Aim Assist does
Aim Assist is an SKSE plugin that adds controller aim assist to Skyrim SE/AE without touching mouse and keyboard.
- 🐢 **Friction:** slows your turning while a target sits inside the aim cone.
- 🧲 **Magnetism:** nudges the crosshair toward the target's chest.
- 🎯 **Smart targeting:** hostile only, line of sight, max distance and cone size are all adjustable.
- 🖱️ **Controller only:** it hooks the right-stick look handler, so mouse aiming is never affected.
- 🛠️ **Tunable:** MCM menu, plus `AimAssist.ini` for aim height, distance and invert options.

## 📜 Release history
- **1.0:** first release, with friction, magnetism and an MCM menu.

## 📲 Install
Needs Skyrim SE 1.6.x, [SKSE64](https://skse.silverlock.org/) and [Address Library](https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/32444). The MCM menu also needs [SkyUI](https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/12604) and [MCM Helper](https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/53000).
1. Download `AimAssist-1.0.0.zip` below.
2. Drag it onto the Vortex mods page, then install and enable it.
3. Launch through `skse64_loader.exe`. The log at `Documents/My Games/Skyrim Special Edition/SKSE/AimAssist.log` should say "Look handler hooked".

This is the first build and hasn't been tested in game yet. If it crashes at launch, please open an issue and attach the log.
